architecture: same width-16 masked graph autoencoder; directed recorded calls are symmetrized by this existing model

topology.topology_partitioning: Node/edge selection uses only measured calls through 175000ms; no later call frequencies or edges choose the topology.
topology.explanation_kind: Exact decomposition of reconstruction squared error across measured node features
topology.limitations: Self-supervised reconstruction is not verified fault detection. Chronological partitions share a bounded topology; no banking or causal labels. Zero internal mask fillers are excluded from loss and are not exported as observations.
